name: launch
tagline_zh: 从产品发布到 Product Hunt，你喊一声“要上线了”，它立刻给你一份可执行的 GTM 清单。
tagline_en: From launch to Product Hunt, say 'shipping soon' and get a ready GTM checklist—even waitlist copy, written for you.
desc_en: When the user wants to plan a product launch, feature announcement, or release strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'launch,' 'Product Hunt,' 'feature release,' 'announcement,' 'go-to-market,' 'beta launch,' 'early access,' 'waitlist,' 'product update,' 'how do I launch this,' 'launch checklist,' 'GTM plan,' or 'we're about to ship.' Use this whenever someone is preparing to release something
why_zh: 它把散落的发布流程压缩成一张作战图，连等待列表这种细节都替你想到，比你自己列清单快十倍。
why_en: It compresses launch chaos into one battle plan—down to waitlist copy—so you ship 10x faster than your own checklist.
